Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MS.
Our gross margin expanded by 94 basis points to 59.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $27.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Our cloud segment grew 17% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 19% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.72 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
